system.description:
You protect your mind with a wall of looping, repetitive thought. When you make a saving throw against a Genjutsu without the Unaware keyword, you add a 1d6 bonus to the result.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, you can target another creature, other than yourself, to benefit from this jutsu.

trigger.text: 1 reaction, which you take when you are forced to make an Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma saving throw.
